The North Greenbush Town Court, located in the County of Rensselaer, operates within the 3rd Judicial District Department. This court has jurisdiction over a variety of cases, including criminal, small claims, evictions, and traffic matters. It also addresses speeding tickets issued on I-90. The District Attorney of Rensselaer prosecutes most criminal and traffic ticket matters. Please note that wearing a mask is mandatory in the court, and sessions are held every Tuesday at 5:30 pm.

How to Search for Case Records

Information regarding North Greenbush Town Court cases can be accessed through the town clerk’s office and the county clerk’s office. Case details are also available online through various platforms. You can search for case records using the following methods:

  • By Name
  • By Case Number
  • By Address
  • By Phone
  • By Email

Some information may not be available online due to confidentiality laws. In such cases, you can obtain records by filing a record request form, which includes your name, phone number, email, address, city, state, zip code, and any other required details. Include fees for record copies, and the court will inform you of the information's availability.

How to Make Payments

Payments for tickets and fines at the North Greenbush Town Court can be made via:

  1. In-Person: Payments can be made during regular hours using cash, checks, or credit cards. Note that a 2.99% convenience fee applies to credit card payments.
  2. Mail: Send a certified check or money order to the court’s mailing address. Personal checks and cash are not accepted by mail. Ensure you include your citation number and send the payment in a self-addressed, stamped envelope if you wish to receive a receipt.
  3. Online and Phone: Currently, the court does not accept payments via phone or online methods.

Types of Cases Handled

The North Greenbush Town Court addresses a range of traffic offenses, including:

  • Driving with a suspended or expired license
  • Reckless driving or driving under the influence
  • Speeding violations
  • Operating vehicles with improper tags
  • Failing to yield or stop at signals
  • Not wearing a seatbelt
  • Using mobile phones while driving
  • Disobeying traffic control devices

Plea Options Available

If you receive a traffic ticket, you can handle your case by entering a plea via mail without attending court. Download the plea form, include your ticket or case number, and submit your plea before the date on your citation. Available pleas include:

  1. Plea of Guilty: Acknowledge your violation and provide an explanation. The court will review your plea and respond with instructions regarding court appearance or payment of fines.
  2. Plea of Not Guilty: If you contest the charges, submit your defense along with supporting evidence. The court will schedule a hearing, and you must appear with your evidence and, if needed, legal representation.

If you are under 18, you must include the name and address of your parent or guardian on the form.

Filing a Small Claim Case

To file a small claim at the North Greenbush Town Court, complete the small claim case form, providing your personal information and the details of the person you are suing. The filing fee is $10 for claims under $1,000 and $15 for claims up to $3,000. Guides are available in court and on the website for assistance.

Eviction Process

The eviction process in North Greenbush Town Court begins with submitting the original petition notice. A $20 filing fee is required to secure a court date. The petition notice must be served at least ten days before the court date, and the Original Affidavit of Service must be filed three days prior to the court date.

Public Defender Access

You may request a public defender if charged with a violation or felony and meet the financial criteria. Obtain the public defender form during your court appearance, and if eligible, the court will appoint counsel for your case.

Conclusion

In conclusion, the Town of North Greenbush offers a variety of resources and services to its residents, including the North Greenbush Town Hall, located at 2 Douglas Street, Wynantskill, NY. Whether you're looking for information on the North Greenbush zoning map, accessing North Greenbush tax bills, or exploring local events, this town provides ample support through its various departments, such as the North Greenbush Building Department and North Greenbush Highway Department.

Residents can also enjoy the recreational opportunities at the North Greenbush Town Park and North Greenbush Town Beach, making it a vibrant community for families and individuals alike. If you have any inquiries, the North Greenbush Town Clerk is available to assist you, along with the North Greenbush Fire Department and North Greenbush Police to ensure safety and community well-being.

For those seeking information about public infrastructure, the North Greenbush Pipeline and North Greenbush Water services are crucial to the town’s operations. Keep an eye on the North Greenbush news for updates on North Greenbush events, local job opportunities, and other community announcements.

With its strategic location and dedicated municipal services, the Town of North Greenbush continues to thrive, offering a rich quality of life for its residents. Whether you're a long-time resident or a newcomer, this community is committed to enhancing the living experience for all its members.
